papers.title: 通过模式映射恢复实现虚拟知识图谱的本体层更新
papers.titleEn: Ontology-Based Update in Virtual Knowledge Graphs via Schema Mapping Recovery
papers.summary: 在固定本体、映射和源模式下，如何把本体层的增删请求落实到关系数据？本文借助模式映射的最大恢复，连接数据来源分支与源更新候选，并按选定度量比较本体副作用。它分别处理批量删除和插入，为理解VKG更新提供理论基础；混合增删、源约束优化与工程实现仍是后续工作，最坏搜索成本呈指数增长。
papers.whySelected: 较早论文 · 首次发现。直接对应固定规范下的VKG实例更新，可回溯后续补偿更新方法所依赖的最大恢复与lineage基础；不是已读种子论文的重复推荐。

papers.summaryEn: With the ontology, mappings and source schema fixed, how can ontology-level insertion or deletion requests be realized in relational data? This paper uses maximum recovery of schema mappings to connect lineage branches with candidate source updates and compare ontology side effects under a chosen metric. It treats batches of deletions and insertions separately, providing a theoretical foundation for understanding VKG updates. Mixed updates, optimization using source constraints and implementation remain future work, and worst-case search cost grows exponentially.

papers.title: SuperMimic：用一个可微世界模型扩展人形全身控制
papers.titleEn: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
papers.summary: 大规模人形动作跟踪通常依赖昂贵的无模型强化学习。SuperMimic从仿真转移学习一个共享可微动力学模型，通过短时想象轨迹反传来训练策略。作者报告单张H100训练三小时超过SONIC已发布策略的回报，并在129514段动作上失败25次，延长训练后为零。论文展示真机G1迁移，但硬件和数据量不同，且训练限于平地，不能把算力比直接当作同条件比较。
papers.summaryEn: Large-scale humanoid motion tracking usually relies on costly model-free reinforcement learning. SuperMimic learns shared differentiable dynamics from simulator transitions and trains a policy by backpropagating through short imagined trajectories. The authors report that three hours on one H100 exceed the return of the released SONIC policy, with 25 failures across 129,514 motions and none after longer training. The paper demonstrates transfer to a real G1, but hardware and data sizes differ and training is confined to flat ground, so the compute ratio is not a matched comparison.

papers.title: Muninn：让轨迹扩散模型更快
papers.titleEn: Muninn: Your Trajectory Diffusion Model But Faster
papers.summary: 扩散轨迹规划的多步去噪拖慢实时控制。Muninn不重训模型，而用浅层特征变化及采样器敏感度估计复用去噪结果的误差，再按轨迹偏差预算决定缓存或重算。作者在离线强化学习、机械臂规划和视觉操作中报告最高4.6倍加速，并验证导航与操作硬件。保证约束的是相对原模型的轨迹偏差，依赖校准可交换性，不能等同于任意环境下无碰撞。
papers.summaryEn: Multistep denoising slows real-time diffusion trajectory planning. Without retraining, Muninn uses shallow-feature changes and sampler sensitivity to estimate the error from reusing denoiser outputs, then chooses caching or recomputation under a trajectory-deviation budget. The authors report up to 4.6× speedups in offline RL, arm planning and visuomotor tasks, with navigation and manipulation hardware tests. Its guarantee concerns deviation from the original model and depends on calibration exchangeability; it is not a universal collision-free guarantee.

papers.title: BooST：连接语义与动作，实现高效机器人技能迁移
papers.titleEn: BooST: Bridging Semantics and Motions for Efficient Skill Transfer
papers.summary: 机器人技能既要表达“做什么”，也要保留“怎么做”。BooST用跨模态VQ-VAE把视觉语言语义与动作轨迹压入共享技能码本，再蒸馏为轻量策略。作者在LIBERO和UR3上检验少样本适配，真实任务每项仅用五次示范，并测试动态视觉干扰。二维图像的深度精度及大视角变化仍是局限，结果不能直接外推为开放世界通用能力。
papers.summaryEn: Robot skills need to encode both intent and motion. BooST combines visual-language features and action trajectories in a shared VQ-VAE skill codebook, then distills it into a lightweight policy. The authors evaluate few-shot adaptation on LIBERO and a UR3, using five demonstrations per real-world task, and test dynamic visual distractions. Depth precision from 2D images and large viewpoint changes remain limitations; these experiments do not establish general open-world capability.
papers.whySelected: 较早论文·首次发现：把语义、动作与部署效率放进同一框架，补充正式期刊视角。 / Older first discovery: a unified treatment of semantics, motion and deployment efficiency adds a formal-journal perspective.
